Container.Name: unraid-dashboard
Container.Overview: Beacon — a modern, self-hosted operations dashboard for Unraid: Docker, storage, VMs, network and system health in one dark-first, installable web app (PWA). Read-only first: dashboards run on a read-only API key, the key never leaves the server, and every mutation is confirmed and audit-logged. This template installs the dashboard container; for the full one-stack install (dashboard + verified-update helper) use the compose bundle in the repository (docs/INSTALL.md) or Unraid 7.2+ Docker → Compose.

Config.Name: Web UI port
Config.Description: Host port for the Beacon web UI

Config.Name: Unraid API URL
Config.Description: Container Variable: UNRAID_URL — Unraid 7.2+ built-in API: http://tower.local (WebGUI host); standalone API plugin: http://tower.local:3005

Config.Name: Unraid API key
Config.Description: Container Variable: UNRAID_API_KEY — read-only key from Unraid Settings → Management Access → API Keys. Stored server-side only.

Config.Name: Appdata
Config.Description: Container Path: /app/data — dashboards, update history and audit log

Config.Name: Prometheus URL
Config.Description: Container Variable: PROMETHEUS_URL — optional; enables history charts, per-container metrics and thermal intelligence

Config.Name: Listen port (container)
Config.Description: Container Variable: PORT — port the app listens on inside the container; keep equal to the Web UI port

Config.Name: Reverse proxy auth mode
Config.Description: Container Variable: AUTH_MODE — set to proxy when Beacon runs behind an authenticating reverse proxy (docs/INSTALL.md)

Config.Name: Proxy auth secret
Config.Description: Container Variable: AUTH_PROXY_SECRET — shared secret your reverse proxy injects (AUTH_MODE=proxy only)

Config.Name: Agent API token
Config.Description: Container Variable: AGENT_API_TOKEN — optional; enables the read-only machine API under /api/agent/v1 (min 32 chars)

Config.Name: VAPID public key
Config.Description: Container Variable: BEACON_VAPID_PUBLIC_KEY — optional; enables Web Push notifications (generate with: npx web-push generate-vapid-keys)

Config.Name: VAPID private key
Config.Description: Container Variable: BEACON_VAPID_PRIVATE_KEY — private half of the push keypair; server-side only, never share. Changing keys invalidates existing subscriptions.

Config.Name: VAPID subject
Config.Description: Container Variable: BEACON_VAPID_SUBJECT — optional contact URI for the push service, e.g. mailto:admin@example.com
